card.name: Just before dose and eGFR numbers
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a dose amount or eGFR value, such as 30 mg or eGFR 25. It appears in dosing-adjustment text in drug labels.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space right before a dose or eGFR figure.
modes.example: increase the ALUNBRIG once daily dose in<< >>30 mg increments after 7 days

modes.label: First digit of eGFR cutoff
modes.description: The digit 2 starting an eGFR or dose value such as 25 or 20.
modes.example: in patients with an eGFR greater than or equal to <<2>>5 mL/min/1.73

card.writes: The promoted tokens are computer and device words, which do not fit this setting, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a dose or kidney-function number in a dosing instruction.
